args.title: Return error status for degraded queue in health check
args.body:
File: src/api/health.ts

Modify the healthRouter readiness check to return an error status (e.g., 503) when the queue status is "degraded" rather than returning HTTP 200. This ensures degraded states are properly reported as errors, not just the "down" state.

args.title: Fix parsing of TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES to handle time strings
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

Change the parsing logic of the TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES environment variable to correctly handle time strings like '12h'. Currently, the int() function is used, which expects a numeric value in minutes and fails to convert '12h' (12 hours) to the correct minute value, interpreting it as 12 instead of 720. The fix should either implement parsing for these time strings or validate the input to reject non-integer values.
